13.name: Grace Cummings, Michael Paynter, Chloe Petts & Pete Helliar
13.overview: Grace Cummings and Michael Paynter sing about stuck toilets and butt-scooting dogs. Chloe Petts and Pete Helliar provide the laughs. A viola da gamba provides the tunes. And Missy Higgins closes the show.

13.name: Ruel, Deborah Cheetham Fraillon, Olga Koch & Tom Ballard
13.overview: Why does pop star Ruel always lie down? Why does Deborah Cheetham Fraillon perform in slippers? What does musical fruit really sound like? Olga Koch and Tom Ballard are on board to help answer.

13.name: Buyi Zama, Amy Shark, Joel Creasey & Tyrone Pynor
13.overview: Two brand new games - one tests your memory and the other tests your ability to discern country lyrics from Barnaby Joyce quotes. Guests are Buyi Zama, Amy Shark, Joel Creasey and Tyrone Pynor. Keli Holiday closes the show.

13.name: Caleb Harper, Dami Im, Nikki Britton & Andrew Maxwell
13.overview: We look at Eurovision history. Australia has tonight's guest, Dami Im. Ireland has Dustin the Turkey. Plus Spacey Jane's Caleb Harper, comedians Nikki Britton and Andrew Maxwell. Julia Jacklin closes the show.

13.name: Zoe Coombs Marr, Rhonda Burchmore, Zion Garcia & Brett Blake
13.overview: Discussing the importance of The Wiggles in Australian cinema are both kinds of guests, Country (Zoe Coombs Marr) and Western (Rhonda Burchmore, Zion Garcia, Brett Blake). Robert Forster performs one of Alan's favourites.

13.name: Kate Hiller-Heidke, Noah Szto, Denise Scott & Toshi Maeda
13.overview: Guests include Kate Miller-Heidke and as a result of her long name, I can't fit much else like Noah Szto, Denise Scott or Toshi Maeda. Oops, now I will really run out of room. Also Bill Shorten turns up in a new game that ..

13.name: BARKAA, Chris Cheney, Nina Oyama & Hannah Gadsby
13.overview: BARKAA, Chris Cheney, Nina Oyama and Hannah Gadsby dissect the music of Sydney, San Francisco, ukulele bands, Australian hip hop, and Grace Jones' ability to party. Miss Kaninna closes the show with a certified banger.

13.name: John Safran, Katie Noonan, Noah Hill & Bec Charlwood
13.overview: John Safran admits what he did in Kanye's house. Katie Noonan grunts like Keith Jarrett. Noah Hill reveals why Parcels put Chiko Rolls in a video. And Bec Charlwood admits her own wardrobe mistake. Plus WILSN closes the show.

13.name: Jaida Stephenson, Watty Thompson, Tommy Little & Felicity Ward
13.overview: Guests Watty Thompson, Felicity Ward, Tommy Little and Jaida Stephenson from Teen Jesus and the Jean Teasers discuss what Ed Sheeran got up to in Japan and the fashion sense of Nicki Minaj. Regurgitator close the show.

13.name: Sheridan Harbridge, Lucas Harwood, Jordan Barr & Takashi Wakasugi
13.overview: An unfair battle between Sheridan Harbridge and Takashi Wakasugi. A face off between Jordan Barr and an elephant. We stop Lucas Harwood making three more King Gizzard albums just by being there. Big Noter rock the closer.

13.name: Casey Donovan, Jett Blyton, Geraldine Hickey & Colin Lane
13.overview: Casey Donovan, Jett Blyton, Geraldine Hickey and Colin Lane discuss the Thatcher effect, things that rhyme with Sydney, the difference between a crow and a raven. Zoe Coombs Marr cameos as a vampire and Ruby Fields closes.

13.name: Nic Buc, Becca Hatch, Kath Ebbs & Frank Woodley
13.overview: You just can't get enough of this series. Conductor Nicholas Buc, singer Becca Hatch, presenter Kath Ebbs and comedian Frank Woodley name songs as played by Dave O'Neil's arhythmic heart. The Blitz Kids close.

overview:
Adam Hills, one of Australia's favourite comedians and winner of Edinburgh's Best of the Fest award, is joined by two team captains, comedian and actor Alan Brough and radio breakfast announcer Myf Warhurst, as well as brave personalities who enjoy having long forgotten embarrassing stories laughed about on national television.

Two teams go head to head as they sing, shout and delve deep into the recesses of their collective minds to help earn their team an extremely inglorious victory.

seasons.name: Season 12
seasons.overview: It was twenty years ago that Adam Hills asked Australia to play. Now he is back with Myf Warhurst and Alan Brough for an all-new platinum season of Spicks and Specks.

seasons.name: Season 13
seasons.overview: Stop! Hey, what's that sound? It can only be the opening notes of Spicks and Specks, heralding in a brand-new series. Adam, Myf and Alan are back, pondering the big music questions as well as sweating the small stuff.

title: Spicks and Specks
